tips.text: Research in a small Ghost clan; research costs multiply with clan size.
Start both research timers first; they run back to back, so gather the materials while they tick.
Join a clan that already has the Tenno Lab and Lacera researched, and you pay only the blueprint and build.
Stockpile Polymer Bundle and Rubedo before you start the build; they dwarf the research cost.
Most players carry the Ceti Lacera for endgame, since it is a straight upgrade.
